name: Attack Chudan tsuki
label: Attack · Chudan tsuki — straight punch to the solar plexus
description: Mune tsuki: Uke steps through with the right foot into a long, low right hanmi and drives the right fist straight at Tori's solar plexus, the arm straight, the left fist pulled back to the hip. In motion: left hanmi kamae with the right fist at the hip, then the lunge. Uke walks in from about two metres into it.
